text: A shy dusk fox with a lantern burning at the tip of its tail, which marks safe paths. Brush adults for Lantern Down.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 2 Raw Game and up to 1 March Leather. Breed with **sweet berries**.

Lantern Foxes live in Overworld forests and almost everywhere in the March: most of all in the Snow Fields, but also on the Steppe, in the Highlands, the Crystal Fields, the Reed Fen, the Glimmer Ridge and even the Ember Wastes.
A fox has **14 health** and no armour. It bolts when hurt and avoids monsters. Breed two with **sweet berries**.
pages.title: Where you find it

text: Brush an adult for **Lantern Down**, once a minute. Down binds into 2 Spiritweave under Water, and the Colony-keepers favour it as an offering.
A hunted fox drops Raw Game and sometimes March Leather, but never its down, so brushing is the only way to get that.
pages.title: What it gives

text: A bonded fox is a lantern that follows you. It carries an invisible light wherever it walks, gives you Night Vision while you stay close, and marks nearby ores with glints only you can see.
The details are on the [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts) page.
pages.title: As a familiar
Hunting and herding
text: When hunted it drops this, more with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
